krillinai-opencreator-krillinai-cli.description: Use when an agent needs to build or operate the embedded KrillinAI CLI, choose a supported command, or interpret its JSON, manifest, subtitle, dubbing, render, cover, speech, and voice outputs.

krillinai-opencreator-krillinai-cover.description: Use when generating a cover image with the KrillinAI CLI from a complete image prompt, including validating image-provider configuration and inspecting the generated image and saved prompt.

krillinai-opencreator-krillinai-pipeline.description: Use when validating or documenting a multi-stage KrillinAI CLI output plan; the current pipeline command supports dry-run planning only, not end-to-end execution.

krillinai-opencreator-krillinai-render-h.description: Use when rendering landscape videos with KrillinAI CLI, including original video plus bilingual subtitles or dubbed video plus target-language subtitles.

krillinai-opencreator-krillinai-render-v.description: Use when rendering portrait videos with KrillinAI CLI, including converting source video to vertical format, adding short bilingual subtitles, rendering dubbed vertical videos, and checking vertical subtitle readability.

krillinai-opencreator-krillinai-subtitle.description: Use when generating subtitles with KrillinAI CLI from a YouTube link, Bilibili/local video, or existing media, including platform caption download, Whisper fallback, translation, bilingual SRT, and short vertical subtitle output.

krillinai-opencreator-krillinai-tts.description: Use when generating target-language dubbing with KrillinAI CLI from SRT subtitles, including TTS audio creation and optional dubbed video generation.

krillinai-opencreator-apps-daemon-runtim.description: OpenCreator 内部 Creator Agent 的稳定运行规则，仅由应用自动安装和激活。

krillinai-opencreator-writing-templates-.description: 本模板接入自 `Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills`，用于提升科研论文和学术内容的章节结构、段落流畅性、论点证据对齐及审稿人可读性。上游说明其大部分写作知识与方法来自彭思达教授公开的学习笔记和 `pengsida/learning_research`；本模板保留该归属，并将方法适配到 OpenCreator 的写作流程。
本模板接入自 `KKKKhazix/khazix-skills` 中的 `khazix-writer`。它提取原 Skill 的写作方法用于文章生成，不代表原作者本人发言，也不允许冒充「数字生命卡兹克」或自动添加原账号署名、联系方式和固定推广尾部。
这是一套来自 `KKKKhazix/sun-style-writing`、经 OpenCreator 接入的非虚构叙事规则。使用写作技法本身，不要求复刻任何现实人物的独特口吻。
- 选题写清目标读者要解决的问题、完成后的具体结果和适用边界。 - 大纲按执行顺序排列步骤，每一步都说明目的、动作、输入输出和常见风险。 - 正文优先使用清单、表格、示例和验证方式；命令、版本、数据不得脱离来源臆造。 - 结尾给出能够逐项核对的完成检查，而不是泛泛总结。
